records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net sales were $102.6 million for the three months ended March 31, 2022 compared to $103.3 million in the three months ended March 31, 2022, a decrease of $0.7 million, or 0.7%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The decrease in sales for the three months ended March 31, 2022 compared to the same period in 2021 is a result of chassis and component shortages leading to lower production and deliveries at Work Truck Solutions.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In addition, volumes were down at Work Truck Attachments in the three months ended March 31, 2022 when compared to the same period in the prior year.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The increase in the three months ended March 31, 2022 was primarily due to pricing actions.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net cash used in operating activities increased $50.1 million from the three months ended March 31, 2021 to the three months ended March 31, 2022.
